scientific_integrity: An exact atomic-pair spectrum checker is provided as finite corroboration, while the all-prime/all-dimension/all-depth implication is supported by a structural two-pebble proof rather than computation alone.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to two-variable first-order logic without counting quantifiers, and to finite nontrivial elementary abelian prime groups with a named zero and ternary relational addition. No extension to three-variable formulas, functional languages or nonprime exponents is claimed; historical priority is not exhaustively verified and independent mathematical audit has not occurred.
title: Six complete two-variable theories of finite elementary abelian prime groups
